scope: GEO catalog metadata; file payloads, biological independence and cross-assay pairing not verified

title: AP-1 mediated chromatin changes govern alveolar type 2 cell transition in lung injury-repair [multiome]
overall_design: performed single-cell multiome sequencing for RNA and ATAC on 8 week old SftpcCreER/+;RosaSun1GFP/+ and SftpcCreER/+;RosaSun1GFP/+;FosF/F;FosbF/F;JunbF/F mice infected with Sendai virus or mock PBS, harvested 14 days post infection, and sorted for ECAD+ epithelial cells
type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
Genome binding/occupancy profiling by high throughput sequencing

title: Multiome, wildtype PBS control lung epithelial cells, GEX
extract_protocol_ch1: Epithelial cells from 8 week old SftpcCreER/+;RosaSun1GFP/+ and SftpcCreER/+;RosaSun1GFP/+;FosF/F;FosbF/F;JunbF/F mice were sorted from Sendai infected or PBS mock infected lungs 14 days post infection and cell extraction was performed with 10X genomics manufacturer instructions
libraries were generatd using the 10X Genomics Single Cell Multiome ATAC + Gene Expression kit with 10,000 nuclei loaded per lane
description: all samples were aggregated to one processed data file
data_processing: Cellranger-arc (version 2.0.0) was used to run “cellranger-arc count” on all samples to align fastq files to a custom mm10 reference genome containing the Sun1GFP and Fos-GFP transcripts. Wildtype control, wildtype Sendai infected, mutant control, and mutant Sendai infected samples were then aggregated together using “cellranger-arc aggr”.
Assembly: custom reference of mm10 with the addition of Sun1GFP and FosGFP sequences

Supplementary files format and content: cellranger-outputs: totalaggr_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5, totalaggr_atac_fragments.tsv.gz, totalaggr_atac_fragments.tsv.gz.tbi, totalaggr_atac_peak_annotation.tsv, totalaggr_atac_peaks.bed, totalaggr_cloupe.cloupe
